parameters.text: This PDF should be an NSW electricity distributor approval for a solar/battery connection (Ausgrid Notification Letter, Endeavour PTC / connection of generator, Essential connection approval). Reply with JSON only, no prose: {"isApprovalLetter": true|false, "nmi": "<NMI exactly as printed>", "reference": "<the distributor's approval / job / reference number>", "distributor": "Ausgrid"|"Endeavour"|"Essential"}
